description: Materialize a slice of a TM1 cube via MDX as a Dagster DataFrame asset. Two modes: (1) explicit MDX statement executed via /ExecuteMDX, or (2) simplified cube + row_dimensions + column_dimensions + filters, from which an MDX is generated. Foundation for TM1 → warehouse / dbt / dashboards.

outputs.description: pandas DataFrame with one row per vendor record. Chain a downstream sink component (dataframe_to_snowflake / _to_bigquery / _to_duckdb / ...) to persist.

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Asset key for the emitted DataFrame.

mdx.label: MDX
mdx.description: Explicit MDX statement. If set, row/column/filter fields are ignored.

row_dimensions.label: Row Dimensions
row_dimensions.description: Simplified mode: dimensions on the row axis.

column_dimensions.label: Column Dimensions
column_dimensions.description: Simplified mode: dimensions on the column axis.

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Simplified mode: {dimension: member} WHERE clause. On a partitioned run {partition_key}, {partition_date}, {partition_start} and {partition_end} (and {partition_<dimension>} for multi-partitions) are substituted.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a markdown preview of the fetched rows in the materialization metadata.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Max rows to include in the preview when include_preview_metadata is True.
